tour.title: Interactive User Experience & Pipeline Dashboard
tour.description: Start at the Streamlit frontend. It coordinates image uploading, real-time quality heuristics, model selection, live before/after comparisons, and output export.

tour.title: Multi-Stage Pre-Restoration Pipeline
tour.description: Real-world inputs frequently contain compound degradations. The pre-restoration pipeline sequentially applies Non-Local Means denoising, unsharp deblurring, CLAHE contrast enhancement, and JPEG artifact deblocking prior to super-resolution.

tour.title: Deep Residual Feature Learning (SRResNet)
tour.description: Explore the foundational deep residual architecture. It leverages 16 residual blocks with identity skips, PReLU activations, and PixelShuffle sub-pixel convolution upsampling for high mathematical fidelity.

tour.title: Adversarial Training & Perceptual Realism (SRGAN)
tour.description: Examine the generative adversarial formulation. SRGAN pairs the SRResNet generator with a VGG-style binary discriminator and optimizes a combined loss of pixel L1, VGG-19 perceptual features, and adversarial cross-entropy.

tour.title: Real-World SOTA Super-Resolution (Real-ESRGAN)
tour.description: Inspect the ESRGAN / Real-ESRGAN architecture. It removes Batch Normalization to eliminate tile artifacts, employs Residual-in-Residual Dense Blocks (RRDB), and integrates Relativistic average GAN (RaGAN) for photorealistic textures.

tour.title: Training Infrastructure & Loss Balancing
tour.description: Discover the modular training engine. Features automated mixed precision (AMP), gradient clipping, cosine annealing learning rate schedules, and resilient checkpoint saving.

tour.title: Evaluation, Benchmarks & Quality Assurance
tour.description: Conclude with the quantitative verification framework. Benchmarks models across validation datasets, calculating PSNR vs HR, SSIM, Delta-vs-Bicubic baseline improvement, and inference latency.
